description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

The boundary between your psyche and others has become dangerously thin and can bleed into each other. You emit a disconcerting psychic pressure on all sentient beings within Willpower yards and they instinctively know you are the source of their discomfort. The thin mental barriers enable you to telepathically reach out to the mind of others within Willpower yards that you either can see or that you know are in the area. With a successful Average (+20) Willpower Test, you can as an Action project your thoughts into another's mind. While the connection is open, within the same Round, they may reply in the same manner without a Test. Social Skills like Charm and Intimidation apply as for normal communication. You may also, with a successful Opposed Willpower Test, pluck thoughts from someones mind. Superficial thoughts (whatever they are thinking at that moment) have no modifier, but trying to plunder memories receive a -30 modifier. You cannot raid the subconscious (things the consciousness won't acknowledge). You need to score 2 or more SL otherwise the Target becomes aware of your transgression. I you fail an Opposed Willpower Test when using this ability on a target, then you cannot target them again until you've rested for 8 hours. Your ability has no effect on non-sentient creatures, like animals, zombies and constructs. Fumbling when using your telepathic powers cause a @Table[minormis]{Minor Miscast}.
